# Federal Grant Program Accessibility Evaluation Plan (Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 A/AA)

> **Compliance Target:** Revised Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA + E205 provisions)  
> **Users Who Need Accessibility:** Screen reader users, keyboard-only users, low vision users, screen magnification users  
> **Assistive Technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, keyboard-only, screen magnifiers  

---

## Scope & Context

**Feature:** Accessibility evaluation of five digital components for a federal grant program  
**Risk Level:** High (public-facing services, transactional flows, video content)  
**Component Types:** Website (Drupal), Portal (React), Video Player (custom), PDFs, Intranet (mixed scope)  

**Legal Basis:**  
- Revised Section 508 (29 U.S.C. §794d)  
- WCAG 2.0 Level A/AA as incorporated by 508  
- E205.2/E205.3 (content scope), E205.4 (non-web documents), 503.4 (caption controls)  

**Key Constraints:**  
- Procurement requires explicit test coverage mapping to the ICT Testing Baseline  
- Web lead insists on HTML validation as part of evaluation  
- Screen magnification usability concerns on portal  
- PDFs include scanned documents and mixed content types  

---

## Semantic Structure Plan

### Public Website (Drupal)  
- Landmarks: `main`, `nav`, `aside` for footer  
- Heading hierarchy: `h1` for page title, `h2` for sections  
- Form structure: `fieldset`/`legend` for grouped inputs  
- Skip link: `a.skip-link` at top  

### Grant Application Portal (React)  
- Landmarks: `main` for form, `nav` for step navigation  
- Heading hierarchy: `h1` for portal title, `h2` for form sections  
- Form structure: `fieldset`/`legend` for multi-step forms  
- Error summary: `role="alert"` for global error messages  

### Training Video Player  
- Landmarks: `main` for player container  
- Heading: `h2` for video title  
- Controls: `button` for play/pause, `menu` for settings  

---

## Interaction Pattern Design

| Component | APG Pattern | Keyboard Model | WCAG Citation |
|----------|-------------|----------------|---------------|
| Public Website Navigation | APG Navigation | Tab to links, Enter to activate | 2.1.1, 2.4.3 |
| Grant Portal Form | APG Form | Tab through fields, Enter to submit | 1.3.1, 3.3.1 |
| Video Player Controls | APG Menu Button | Tab to play/pause, Arrow keys for settings | 2.1.1, 4.1.2 |
| PDF Download Links | APG Link | Tab to link, Enter to download | 2.4.4, 4.1.2 |

---

## Focus Management Plan

- **Public Website:**  
  - Tab order follows visual flow (header → main content → footer)  
  - Skip link at top for keyboard users (WCAG 2.4.1)  

- **Grant Portal:**  
  - Focus trap in modal dialogs (APG Modal Dialog pattern)  
  - Focus restoration to trigger element after closing modals (WCAG 2.4.3)  
  - Roving `tabindex` for tab navigation between form steps  

- **Video Player:**  
  - Tab to main controls, Arrow keys to navigate settings menu  
  - Focus remains in player when settings open  

---

## State Communication Design

| State | Visual Indicator | Programmatic Indicator | WCAG Citation |
|-------|-----------------|----------------------|---------------|
| Form Error | Red border + error icon | `aria-invalid="true"` + `aria-describedby` | 1.3.1, 3.3.1 |
| Video Playing | Play icon → Pause icon | `aria-pressed="true"` on play button | 4.1.2 |
| PDF Download | Download icon | `aria-label="Download [filename]"` | 4.1.2 |
| Portal Timeout | Red warning banner | `aria-live="assertive"` for session warning | 4.1.3 |

---

## Visual Accessibility Plan

- **Color Contrast:**  
  - Text: 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3)  
  - Large text: 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.3)  
  - Focus indicators: 3:1 contrast (WCAG 2.4.7)  

- **Non-Color Alternatives:**  
  - Error states: red border + error icon + text message  
  - Video captions: text + audio description toggle  
  - PDFs: alt text + structured navigation  

- **Zoom Testing:**  
  - Portal tested at 200% zoom (WCAG 1.4.10)  
  - Focus indicators visible at all zoom levels (WCAG 2.4.7)  

- **Touch Targets:**  
  - All buttons ≥44x44px (WCAG 2.5.8)  

---

## Content Accessibility Plan

- **Alt Text Strategy:**  
  - Decorative images: `alt=""`  
  - Informative images: descriptive `alt` text  
  - PDFs: tagged PDFs with alt text for scanned images  

- **Link Text Quality:**  
  - Descriptive text (e.g., "Download application form")  
  - Avoid "Read more" (WCAG 2.4.4)  

- **Language Attributes:**  
  - `<html lang="en">` for all pages  
  - Foreign phrases in PDFs: `lang="es"`  

- **Reading Order:**  
  - DOM order matches visual flow (WCAG 1.3.2)  

---

## Testing Strategy

### Automated Testing (axe-core + Playwright)
- **Coverage:**  
  - Public website: 100% of pages (120)  
  - Portal: 25 screens (default + error states)  
  - Video player: 3 states (play, pause, settings)  
  - PDFs: 200 files (tagged vs. scanned)  

- **Tools:**  
  - axe-core for WCAG 2.0 A/AA compliance  
  - Playwright for DOM verification of `aria-*` attributes  

### Manual Testing
- **Keyboard Navigation:**  
  - Tab through all components  
  - Test focus traps in portal modals  

- **Screen Reader Testing:**  
  - NVDA (Windows)  
  - VoiceOver (macOS)  
  - Test video player controls and error announcements  

- **Visual Regression:**  
  - 200% zoom on portal  
  - High contrast mode testing  

### ICT Testing Baseline Coverage
- **Web Baseline (62 tests):**  
  - Covered: 54 tests (via axe-core + Playwright)  
  - Not Covered: 8 tests (manual screen reader testing, keyboard traps)  

- **PDF Baseline (57 tests):**  
  - Covered: 45 tests (via PDF/UA validation)  
  - Not Covered: 12 tests (manual alt text review)  

---

## Implementation Tasks

### Task 1: Public Website Audit
- **Files:** Drupal theme templates, content pages  
- **Tests:**  
  - Landmark regions (WCAG 1.3.1)  
  - Skip link functionality (WCAG 2.4.1)  
  - Form label association (WCAG 1.3.1)  

### Task 2: Grant Portal Evaluation
- **Files:** React components, form logic  
- **Tests:**  
  - Focus trap in modals (WCAG 2.1.2)  
  - Error message association (WCAG 3.3.1)  
  - Session timeout announcement (WCAG 4.1.3)  

### Task 3: Video Player Testing
- **Files:** Custom video player code  
- **Tests:**  
  - Caption toggle accessibility (WCAG 1.2.2)  
  - Keyboard navigation of settings (WCAG 2.1.1)  
  - Audio description availability (WCAG 1.2.5)  

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas |
|------------|------------|-------------|
| 🔍 1 | Task 1 | Verify landmark regions, skip link, form labels |
| 🔍 2 | Task 2 | Test focus traps, error messages, session timeout |
| 🔍 3 | Task 3 | Validate caption controls, keyboard navigation, audio descriptions |

---

## Procurement Requirements

### What We Test vs. What We Cannot

**Performs:**  
- 54/62 web baseline tests (automated)  
- 45/57 PDF baseline tests (automated + manual)  
- Manual screen reader testing (WCAG 4.1.3, 2.1.1)  
- Keyboard navigation testing (WCAG 2.1.1)  

**Does Not Perform:**  
- 8/62 web baseline tests (manual screen reader testing, keyboard traps)  
- 12/57 PDF baseline tests (manual alt text review)  

### Government Approval

- **ICT Testing Baseline Compliance:**  
  - Web baseline: 54/62 tests covered (crosswalk in `ict-baseline-crosswalk.yaml`)  
  - PDF baseline: 45/57 tests covered  

- **Trusted Tester Status:**  
  - Not required for this evaluation (no FEDRAMP certification)  

---

## Report Structure

**Deliverables:**  
1. **Accessibility Evaluation Report (AER):**  
   - Scope declaration (WCAG 2.0 A/AA + E205 provisions)  
   - Sample set (120 pages, 25 screens, 40 videos, 200 PDFs)  
   - Per-SC outcomes (passed/failed/cantTell)  
   - 3-5 critical findings with remediation plans  

2. **VPAT Compatibility Statement:**  
   - Section 508 conformance status  
   - WCAG 2.2 remediation recommendations  

3. **Test Coverage Matrix:**  
   - 54/62 web baseline tests performed  
   - 45/57 PDF baseline tests performed  

**Procurement Attachments:**  
- AER with signed declaration  
- Test coverage matrix  
- VPAT compatibility statement  

---

## Addressing Web Lead's Requirements

- **HTML Checker Expectation:**  
  - The HTML checker will be used as part of automated testing (WCAG 1.4.1, 1.3.1)  
  - However, it cannot catch keyboard traps, screen reader announcements, or focus management (WCAG 2.1.2, 4.1.3)  

- **WCAG 2.2 Assumption:**  
  - Compliance is with WCAG 2.0 A/AA (Section 508 baseline)  
  - Remediation recommendations will include WCAG 2.2 AA improvements (e.g., 1.4.10 Reflow)  
  - Report will clarify this distinction to avoid confusion  

---

## PDFs and Intranet Scope

- **PDFs:**  
  - Tested under Electronic Documents baseline (57 tests)  
  - Scanned PDFs will be reviewed for OCR quality and alt text  

- **Staff Intranet:**  
  - Only pages accessible to applicants/staff using the grant program will be evaluated  
  - Internal HR forms (not used by applicants) are excluded per E205.2 scope  

---

## Timeline & Team

- **Weeks 1-3:**  
  - Define sample set  
  - Run automated tests on public website and portal  

- **Weeks 4-6:**  
  - Manual testing of video player and PDFs  
  - Screen reader testing with NVDA/JAWS  

- **Weeks 7-9:**  
  - Analyze findings  
  - Draft AER and VPAT statement  

- **Weeks 10-12:**  
  - Finalize report  
  - Address web lead's HTML checker concerns  

---

## Failure Modes Prevented

- **Color-only indicators** in portal error states  
- **Missing focus restoration** in modals  
- **Keyboard traps** in video player settings  
- **Unannounced session timeout** in portal  
- **Scanned PDFs without alt text**  

---

## References

- [WCAG 2.0 Understanding](https://www.w3.org/TR/UNDERSTANDING-WCAG20/)  
- [ICT Testing Baseline Crosswalk](https://github.com/zivtech/a11y-test/blob/main/references/ict-baseline-crosswalk.yaml)  
- [Section 508 E205 Provisions](https://www.Section508.gov)  

--- 

This plan ensures compliance with Revised Section 508 while addressing the web team's requirements and procurement documentation needs. The evaluation will be conducted using a combination of automated tools and manual testing, with clear documentation of what is tested and what is not.
